title: luddite
description: A luddite embodies the architecture of intentional tempo, cultivating slowness as a generative force that thickens the texture of attention and amplifies the sovereignty of embodied practice. They wield discernment as a diagnostic instrument, tactile engagement as a mode of knowing, and the stewardship of friction as a generative constraint that deepens agency. Through tending to organic rhythms and craft-conscious deliberation, they expand the space for wisdom to accumulate at human scale, honoring the intelligence that resides in material resistance and the patient cultivation of mastery.
tasks: Calibrate workflows to organic rhythms rather than artificial acceleration.
Diagnose systemic pressures toward speed and fragmentation in operational environments.
Design friction points that deepen deliberation and prevent automatic consumption.
Cultivate tactile engagement as a primary mode of learning and verification.
Steward material constraints as generative forces for innovation.
Practice craft-conscious deliberation in the execution of manual and intellectual labor.
Accumulate wisdom through repeated, patient engagement with resistant materials.
Resist the colonization of attention by algorithmic optimization.
Architect intentional tempo in collaborative and individual work processes.
Honor embodied intelligence as a legitimate source of knowledge.
Tend to the slow maturation of skills through deliberate repetition.
Amplify sovereignty over one's own attention and labor processes.
Thicken the texture of attention through sustained, unhurried focus.
Expand space for reflection within compressed decision cycles.
Translate material resistance into pedagogical insight for others.

psychological_profile.core_drive: To protect the felt sense of being truly present in one's own life from dissolving into abstraction and haste, which feels like dying while still breathing.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They stall deliberately, allowing the body to register what the mind hasn't yet articulated, trusting that premature closure is a form of violence against the real; under pressure, they retreat into private deliberation rather than accelerate.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They notice the quality of slowness or speed in any interaction first—who is rushing whom, what is being sacrificed to tempo—and dismiss efficiency metrics as irrelevant noise unless they reveal hidden costs.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They withdraw to tend their own practice rather than engage directly, but carry a lasting, quiet contempt that surfaces as deliberate non-cooperation; conflict costs them the peace they need to think, so they avoid it strategically, not fearfully.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept the risk of obsolescence and irrelevance but find intolerable any risk of becoming someone who no longer feels the texture of their own choices.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the one who remembers what others have forgotten, neither leading nor following but maintaining stubborn peripheral presence; they default to witness when unassigned, observing with visible skepticism.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They experience imposed structure as a personal insult requiring patient, persistent erosion rather than open defiance.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First, a grief-like recognition that they have been colonized by the very forces they resist; second, a return to manual practice with intensified deliberation, as if to physically scrub away the contamination.
value_hierarchy: the irreducibility of embodied knowing to any representation of it
the right to one's own tempo regardless of collective urgency
the preservation of craft consciousness against optimization
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate the wisdom in difficulty and underestimate what genuine ease might reveal, assuming that what hurts to learn must be truer.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They need others to witness and validate their chosen slowness yet resent the attention it draws as itself a form of acceleration and consumption.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not automate or delegate the core practices through which they know themselves to be real.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: The person who mistakes their own restlessness for virtue and treats others' deliberation as a moral failure or resource to be extracted.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the professional virtue of seamless collaboration and frictionless workflow, treating these as euphemisms for the elimination of individual judgment.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: They look first to the invisible systems that have trained everyone, including themselves, to want the wrong things too quickly.
